component.name: dayflow-electron
component.summary: A timeline of your day from periodic screenshots

description.p: Takes a screenshot of the screen under your mouse every few seconds and lets an AI model you choose turn each 15 minutes into timeline cards that say what you did. Screenshots stay on your computer; only the provider you pick sees them, and there is no telemetry.

ul.li: Timeline by day and week, with categories, day summary and export
Cloud providers (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible) or a local model with Ollama or LM Studio
Daily standup notes and a weekly dashboard
Password managers and other blocked apps are never recorded
